title: Zocdoc Booking Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zocdoc:booking
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(specialty) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Zocdoc booking events land each day and how many distinct specialty values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Zocdoc booking records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct specialty values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Zocdoc booking activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
